scenes.setting: Leonard's single room under the crimson moon: he confronts his 'fortuitous encounter' — a Parasite. The aged voice explains why it won't devour him (Evernight vs Apprentice/Seer pathways), that it hides in the Church to recover, and names its terrible enemy: 'Amon.'

Riverbay Avenue at dinner time: Klein, disguised by hallucinatory effects as an arrogant policeman ('A Magician had to do what a magician would do!'), surveys the neighbors about Unit 48 — the Whites, kindly bloodletting physicians, and their silent son Emlyn — confirming a family of law-abiding monsters
scenes.text_anchor: “I have something to ask your master.”

scenes.setting: Inside the hastily abandoned 48 Riverbay Avenue: moonlit disarray, herb books — and a bedroom full of expensive figurines, from a wax-like golden-haired girl to a palm-sized silver-armored heroine. 'Don't tell me Emlyn is a vampire who is obsessed with figurines?'
